objectives.statement: Identify common weak and strong past participle forms.
Use the uninflected past participle after a helping verb in a compound tense.
Choose the right participle form when it works as an adjective before a noun.

notes: Introduce the participle form inventory here, and contrast adjectival participle agreement before nouns with the uninflected participle used in compound tenses. The har + participle perfect construction is taught next in present_perfect.
